# CiteAura

> CiteAura is an evidence-based Generative Engine Optimization platform for website diagnosis, AI visibility measurement, action tickets, verification, and delivery packages.

## Official pages

- [Website](https://citeaura.com/): Product overview and plan information.
- [Application](https://citeaura.com/app/): CiteAura workspace and account access.
- [Documentation](https://citeaura.com/docs): Setup, measurement, execution, verification, and delivery guidance.
- [Privacy Policy](https://citeaura.com/privacy): Data handling and privacy terms.
- [Terms of Service](https://citeaura.com/terms): Service terms and acceptable use.

## Product workflow

- Create a workspace and add a public website domain.
- Audit crawlability, page structure, extractable facts, structured data, and authority signals.
- Measure AI visibility with explicit provenance and sampling-mode labels.
- Convert evidence into prioritized action tickets with acceptance criteria.
- Re-crawl implemented changes and retain verification evidence.
- Export diagnostic reports and delivery assets with explicit readiness states.

## Measurement integrity

- Sampling outputs retain one of these modes: API - Parametric knowledge, API - Search grounded, or Manual - Product interface.
- Unmeasured providers and insufficient sample coverage are disclosed rather than estimated.
- CiteAura does not guarantee AI mentions, rankings, citations, or optimization outcomes.

## Delivery readiness

- Diagnostic readiness, visibility readiness, and implementation readiness are evaluated independently.
- Assets marked as needing review require factual or editorial approval before publication.
- Templates and outlines are implementation inputs, not finished publishable pages.
